nodes.label: Renewable Energy
nodes.summary: Energy from sources that are naturally replenished.

nodes.label: Solar Photovoltaics
nodes.summary: Panels that convert sunlight directly into electricity.

nodes.label: Onshore Wind
nodes.summary: Wind turbines built on land, among the cheapest new power sources.

nodes.label: Offshore Wind
nodes.summary: Turbines at sea that capture stronger and steadier winds.

nodes.label: Hydropower
nodes.summary: Electricity generated by water flowing through dam turbines.

nodes.label: Geothermal Power
nodes.summary: Power drawn from heat stored beneath the Earth's surface.

nodes.label: Bioenergy
nodes.summary: Energy from burning or fermenting organic material.

nodes.label: Intermittency
nodes.summary: Wind and solar output varies with weather and time of day.

nodes.label: Capacity Factor
nodes.summary: Actual output divided by the maximum possible output over time.

nodes.label: Transmission Lines
nodes.summary: High-voltage lines that carry power over long distances.

nodes.label: Smart Grid
nodes.summary: A grid using digital sensors and controls to balance supply and demand.

nodes.label: Feed-in Tariffs
nodes.summary: Guaranteed prices paid to producers of renewable electricity.

nodes.label: Carbon Pricing
nodes.summary: A charge on emissions that makes fossil power more expensive.

nodes.label: Levelized Cost
nodes.summary: Average lifetime cost per unit of electricity generated.

nodes.label: Curtailment
nodes.summary: Deliberately reducing renewable output when the grid cannot absorb it.

nodes.label: Net Metering
nodes.summary: Households are credited for surplus solar power sent to the grid.

nodes.label: Rare Earth Supply
nodes.summary: Turbine magnets depend on scarce rare earth elements.

nodes.label: Land Use
nodes.summary: Solar and wind farms need large areas of land.

nodes.label: Wildlife Impact
nodes.summary: Turbines and dams can harm birds, bats and fish.

nodes.label: Green Jobs
nodes.summary: Renewable industries employ millions of workers worldwide.

nodes.label: Microgrids
nodes.summary: Small local grids that can run independently of the main network.

nodes.label: Energy Efficiency
nodes.summary: Using less energy for the same service reduces required supply.

nodes.label: Electrification
nodes.summary: Switching heating and transport from fuels to electricity.
